shell.darkUnavailable: Dark mode is not available yet

common.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Return to the recruitment dashboard to continue.

eligibility.title: Eligibility review
eligibility.subtitle: See how your profile measures against Talent Directory requirements.
eligibility.belowTitle: You are {{points}} percentage points below the threshold
eligibility.metTitle: You meet the Talent Directory threshold
eligibility.body: Talent Directory visibility requires a Composite Score of at least {{threshold}}% and your recorded consent. This clearly labeled sample does not represent your real score.

courses.title: Complete recommended courses
courses.body: Build the role-specific skills highlighted in your learning plan.

performance.title: Strengthen performance
performance.body: Use internship feedback to improve delivery, teamwork, and consistency.

mentor.title: Meet your mentor
mentor.body: Set practical goals and review progress before your next eligibility check.

eligibility.nextBody: Keep using InternsHub normally. Your eligibility can be reviewed again as your profile improves.

consent.title: Talent Directory consent
consent.subtitle: You control whether eligible employers can discover your profile.
consent.heading: Choose what employers can see
consent.body: Consent is optional and is not required to use courses, mentorship, or other InternsHub features.

profile-visibility.label: I allow eligible employers to view my Talent Directory profile.
profile-visibility.hint: I understand visibility also requires a Composite Score of 80% or higher.

withdrawal.label: I understand I can withdraw consent later.
withdrawal.hint: Withdrawing consent removes future directory visibility without limiting general platform access.

consent.saved: Consent saved for this demo. Nothing was sent to a server.

message.declined: {{company}} has closed this application. Thank you for the time and care you put into applying.
message.selected: {{company}} would like to move forward. Review and sign the liability agreement to continue.
message.not-selected: Another candidate was selected after the completed review. Your profile remains active for future opportunities.

next.declined: Review other applications or speak with your mentor before applying again.
next.selected: The placement is not complete yet. Both parties must sign the agreement and the required completion process must be satisfied.
next.not-selected: Explore matched opportunities and use this experience to strengthen your next application.

agreement.title: Liability agreement
agreement.subtitle: Track signatures before the partner project can begin.
agreement.legalBody: No legal terms are displayed until approved wording is available.
agreement.blockedBody: The real partner project cannot start until both {{student}} and {{company}} have signed.
